checklist.why: Purpose line names Measure for one exact value.
When / when not present; PickerField and ChoiceList exist.
Label, bounds, track, two handles, end labels, optional reason named and shown.
One Range variant used by farrowing.room; generic numeric control.
Default, pressed (dragging), focus, at limits, disabled with reason, error rendered; a live drag sets data-dragging.
Handles 48x48, staggered above/below the track so equal bounds do not overlap (measured at 171,448 and 171,496).
Not a choice control; no cap needed (the README's five-row text is copied boilerplate).
Disabled handles dashed plus a written reason; error is text.
zh value wraps mid-range ('0–' / '5 天') via overflow-wrap:anywhere; the lower limit renders as '-7–-7 days'.
role=slider with valuemin/max/now/text per handle, focus ring, arrows/Home/End, track tap moves the nearer handle — all verified by use.
Value text misstates Farrowing's scale: 'Due in -7–7 days', ends '-7 days'/'7 days', though the bounds mean '7+ days ago' and 'In 7+ days' (the list summary still says so); no formatter prop.
Links FilterSheet, FilterChips, PickerField; component classification stated.
Atlas Range tab logs console 404s from relative asset links in variants/range.html srcdoc cells.

variants.name: Range
findings: Mouse drag (down/move/up) of both handles works, handles never cross, data-dragging set while moving; ArrowLeft/Right, Home, End work; track tap moves the nearer handle; equal bounds stay grabbable.
Raw negative value text and no selected-span fill (see component findings).

findings.text: Value text is raw numbers: Farrowing shows 'Due in -7–7 days', ends '-7 days'/'7 days', and '-7–-7 days' at the limit, while -7/7 are open-ended ('7+ days ago' / 'In 7+ days') and the list summary formats them that way — sheet and list disagree and the sheet is wrong at the ends.
findings.fix: Add a format(value) prop used for output, end labels and aria-valuetext; Farrowing passes dueDay (7+ days ago · Today · In 7+ days).

findings.text: Atlas console not clean: variants/range.html cells request ../../tokens.css, ../bundle.css, ../bundle.js, sentri-icons.js and 404 inside srcdoc.
findings.fix: Remove the asset tags from variants/range.html (atlas injects them) or make them root-relative.

findings.text: The track has no fill between the handles; the chosen span is only implied by two staggered circles with stems, and Farrowing's old 'Today' midpoint label is gone.
findings.fix: Paint the rail segment between the handles with an ink token and add an optional mid-label property.

findings.text: Long zh value breaks inside the number range ('0–' then '5 天').
findings.fix: Use overflow-wrap:break-word on the label and white-space:nowrap on <output>.

findings.text: README carries FilterSheet boilerplate ('Do show current bounds and count', 'Limit short visible choice rows to five', 'Do preserve drafts on Back') that is not RangeSlider's job.
findings.fix: Cut those lines; keep slider rules only (step, bounds never cross, Measure for exact values).

proposals.name: Feed adjustment slider
proposals.why: Inspection's feed edit still uses a hand-built native single range (−50%..+50%); it records a value, so it belongs with Stepper/Measure, not as a RangeSlider variant.
